text.div: Deliberately non-conformant Patient. This resource claims conformance to the HL7® AT Core Patient profile in meta.profile but omits two elements the profile makes mandatory: Patient.name (min = 1) and Patient.gender (min = 1). It is valid against the base FHIR R4 Patient resource, so a FHIR server accepts it on create. Only profile validation can reject it. Used as the negative control for the AT Core profile validation test script.
